name: Clarice Arrives at the Victorian Building with a Plastic Box
description: Clarice walks up the steps of a large Victorian building on Constitution Avenue. She carries a small plastic box, holding it tightly as she approaches the entrance.
related_events: Clarice ascends steps of Victorian building carrying plastic box

name: Truck Departs and Crushes Grocery Bag
description: The truck's engine starts. It begins to back up, and one of its rear wheels hits Catherine's grocery bag, knocking it over and crushing it slightly. The bag spills open, and an orange rolls slowly away from the scattered contents as the truck drives off, its taillights fading in the distance.
related_events: Truck knocks over Catherine's grocery bag while backing up

name: Catherine Retrieves Groceries from the Car
description: Catherine takes a long hit from a bong pipe and leans back, her head resting on Cody's lap as the television plays softly in the background. She sits up and says the marijuana is giving her the munchies, asking where the bag of popcorn is. Cody remembers he left the groceries in the car and starts to get up, but Catherine pushes him back, telling him it's okay. She gets up, walks to the front door, and steps out of the apartment.
related_events: Catherine Martin smokes from a bong pipe
Cody remembers leaving groceries in the car
Catherine decides to retrieve the groceries from the car

name: Clarice Receives Breakthrough Clue in Museum
description: Clarice walks through the dimly lit dinosaur exhibit with a museum guard, surrounded by towering skeletons with hollow eye sockets and jagged teeth. As she moves through the silent hall, Crawford's voice comes over the communication link, telling her they have found another insect inside Raspail's head. The news cuts through the stillness, shifting the weight of the investigation in a new direction.
related_events: Clarice walks through museum dinosaur exhibit with guard
Crawford reveals discovery of second bug in Raspail's head

name: Crawford Learns of the Transfer
description: Crawford stands on the scrambler phone, his expression shifting as he takes in the news. 'Transferred...?' he says, stunned. Burroughs watches from nearby, motionless and silent, his eyes fixed on Crawford as the call ends.
related_events: Crawford receives shocking news during scrambler phone call
Burroughs silently observes Crawford's phone conversation

name: Clarice Responds to Ardelia's Urgent Call
description: Clarice sits at her desk, working a grip flexer in her right hand while reading a thick law book. Ardelia appears at the door, calls out urgently, and tells her to come see something right away.
related_events: Clarice exercises her right hand with a grip flexer while studying a law book
Ardelia interrupts Clarice to urge her to see something urgent

name: Clarice Engages the Target on the Track
description: Clarice stands in a combat stance, wearing a sound-muffling headset, and fires round after round at a silhouette of a man moving toward her along a track. Her shots are tight, each one striking the center of the target's chest. The figure halts, now close to her, and continues to sway slightly. Clarice stares at it, quickly reloading her weapon with a speedloader. She then fires one final shot directly through the target's forehead.
related_events: Clarice fires multiple rounds at a moving target
Target stops and sways near Clarice after being hit
Clarice reloads using a speedloader
Clarice delivers a final shot through the target's forehead

name: Clarice Starling Breaches the Room
description: Clarice Starling, her face tense and glistening with sweat, reloads her revolver with a speedloader, locking it into place with a twist. The knob of the guest room door suddenly explodes with a sharp crack, and the door flies open. A cloud of smoke billows into the hallway. She rounds the corner, shoulders through the shattered doorway, and charges into the room, both hands gripping the revolver, weapon raised and ready.
related_events: Clarice Starling reloads her revolver under tension
Door knob explodes and door bursts open
Clarice Starling rushes into the room through smoke

name: Crawford Takes Over at Bella's Bedside
description: Crawford enters his bedroom and tells the private nurse, Patricia, that he will take over. She nods, hands him the clipboard with the medical chart, and leaves. He glances at the chart briefly, then sets it aside. He walks to the hospital bed where his wife Bella lies unconscious, her breathing shallow and labored. He gently brushes a strand of hair from her face and leans down to kiss her forehead. Outside, thunder rumbles and rain falls.
related_events: Crawford relieves the private nurse and takes charge of his wife's care
Crawford reviews medical chart and sets it aside
Crawford tenderly touches and kisses his comatose wife Bella

name: Dr. Lecter's Return to His Cell
description: Dr. Lecter lies on a rolling hand truck, his feet clad in slippers and his ankles linked by steel restraints. He is bound in a straitjacket, the heavy canvas webbing securing his legs, waist, upper torso, and arms, with a hockey mask covering his face. Barney pushes the hand truck down the corridor, guiding it into Dr. Lecter's open cell. As the truck rolls forward, Chilton's voice carries through the air, delivering the news that Gourmet magazine has rejected Dr. Lecter's recipe for braised kidneys.
related_events: Dr. Lecter is restrained and transported on a rolling hand truck
Barney pushes Dr. Lecter back into his cell
Chilton informs Dr. Lecter of recipe rejection

name: Mr. Yow Reveals Unit 31's Lease Under Miss Hester Mofet
description: Rain streaks down an orange neon sign that glows above a hurricane fence topped with barbed wire. Inside, rows of cinderblock sheds stand in silent alignment. A voice, belonging to Mr. Yow, states that Unit 31 was leased for ten years, paid in full, under the name of Miss Hester Mofet.
related_events: Neon sign identifies location amid rainy conditions
Mr. Yow reveals lease details for storage unit

name: Clarice and Mr. Yow Investigate Under the Door
description: Clarice, backlit, crouches and peers under a door, sweeping the space with her flashlight. The beam reveals shadowy outlines of boxes and the flattened tires of a car. Rain patters on the tin roof, mingled with faint rustling noises. Mr. Yow's face appears beside hers. He sniffs the air and says it smells like mice, that he thinks he hears them too. Clarice turns onto her back and begins to wriggle under the door, slipping into the dark space beneath.
related_events: Clarice peers under the door with a flashlight
Mr. Yow comments on the smell and sounds of mice
Clarice wriggles under the door

name: Police Motorcade and Surveillance Van Enter Freeway in High-Speed Pursuit
description: A line of police vehicles surges through a city intersection, sirens wailing and red and blue lights flashing. Highway patrol cruisers block cross traffic as the motorcade accelerates toward the freeway. The lead cars veer onto the entrance ramp, tires screeching. Close behind, a surveillance van equipped with long antennas and a small satellite dish follows near the front of the formation, moving swiftly into the freeway as the convoy disappears into the distance.
related_events: Police motorcade speeds through intersection with sirens and flashing lights
Surveillance van travels near the front of the police motorcade

name: Clarice Confronts Chilton at the Facility
description: Clarice stands in Dr. Chilton's office, dressed in a tailored skirt suit with her hair neatly coiled, a briefcase in hand. Chilton sits behind a large desk, holding her ID card and studying it with a lingering gaze. He strokes the card with a gold pen and remarks that it's rare to capture one alive. Looking up, he comments on the number of detectives who visit, adding that he can't recall one as attractive as her. He asks if she'll be staying in Baltimore overnight, suggesting the city can be fun with the right guide. Clarice, her expression cool, says she's sure it's a great town but that her instructions are to speak with Dr. Lecter and report back that afternoon. Chilton pauses, his tone turning sour, and says he understands. He declares he's busy and suggests they make the meeting quick.
related_events: Chilton makes a patronizing comment about capturing Clarice alive
Chilton examines Clarice's ID card with inappropriate interest
Chilton inquires about Clarice staying overnight in Baltimore with suggestive tone
Clarice expresses disinterest in Chilton's offer and states her purpose

name: Clarice Enters the Asylum in the Storm
description: A clap of thunder booms as lightning flashes over the asylum, illuminating its tall towers and barred windows. Clarice steps out of her car, drenched by the heavy rain, and runs toward the main entrance. A security guard opens the door and lets her inside.
related_events: Clarice runs from her car to the asylum entrance in the rain
Security guard admits Clarice at the asylum entrance

name: Clarice Arrives at the Asylum in the Storm
description: A loud clap of thunder echoes as a flash of lightning lights up the dark sky, revealing the asylum's towering walls and barred windows. Rain falls heavily, drenching the grounds as Clarice climbs out of her car. She hurries across the wet pavement toward the main entrance, where a guard waits and lets her inside.
related_events: Thunder and lightning illuminate the asylum during a storm

name: Clarice Prepares for Field Assignment
description: Brigham and Clarice walk quickly down a hallway, passing other trainees. He carries a small canvas bag. Brigham tells Clarice to get her field gear and pack for an overnight trip with Crawford. He explains that fishermen in West Virginia found the body of an unidentified girl, and the case resembles the Buffalo Bill investigations. The body has been in the water for about a week, and Jack needs someone who can take fingerprints from a decomposed body. Clarice thinks for a moment, then responds that she will need the large fingerprint kit and the one-to-one Polaroid camera, the CU- model, along with film packs and batteries.
related_events: Brigham informs Clarice about a recovered girl's body in West Virginia
Brigham instructs Clarice to prepare field gear for a forensic assignment
Clarice requests specialized fingerprint and photographic equipment

name: Clarice and Mr. Yow Exchange Safety Advice
description: Clarice pulls her head back out and reaches for her camera, taking it from Mr. Yow. She hands him a card and says, 'Mr. Yow, if this door should fall down—ha ha!—or anything else—would you be kind enough to call this number? It's our Baltimore field office. They know you're here with me... Do you understand?' Mr. Yow replies, 'Might I suggest tucking your pants into your socks? To prevent mouse intrusion.' Clarice pauses, then says, 'Good idea.'
related_events: Clarice retrieves her camera from Mr. Yow
Clarice gives Mr. Yow a contact card with instructions
Mr. Yow advises Clarice to tuck her pants into her socks
Clarice acknowledges Mr. Yow's suggestion about mouse prevention

name: Catherine Helps a Man with an Armchair
description: Catherine straightens up after placing her grocery bag in the car, then notices a man a short distance away struggling to lift an armchair into a brown panel truck. He has his right arm in a cast and sling, and the effort is clearly difficult for him. The parking lot is filled with other vehicles—cars, RVs, a boat on a trailer—and a thin fog hangs just above the ground, lit by yellow pools from overhead arc lights. After a moment, Catherine walks over and asks if he needs help. He accepts quietly, his voice soft and strained. She sets her bag down, and together they lift the armchair into the truck. 'Let's slide it up,' he says from inside the vehicle.
related_events: Catherine exits her car after grocery shopping
Catherine notices a man struggling with an armchair
Catherine decides to approach the man
Catherine offers to help the man with the armchair

name: Catherine Helps Load the Armchair
description: Catherine sets her grocery bag down and approaches the man by the brown panel truck. Together, they lift the armchair and place it inside the truck. The man suggests sliding it forward, and Catherine helps him move it into position.
related_events: Catherine and the man lift the armchair into the truck

name: Clarice Observes Fiber Analysis Linking Buffalo Bill's Crimes
description: In a forensic training room, a large video screen displays a blurry image that slowly sharpens, revealing two separate pieces of fabric. The instructor explains that both blouses were worn by victims of Buffalo Bill, found in different states and four months apart. The camera shows close-ups of the fabric edges, zooming in until individual threads appear as thick as tree limbs. The cuts along the back of each blouse match precisely. The instructor points out the compressed fibers along the edges, noting the bunching is typical of scissors, not a single blade. At the door, John Brigham appears and calls out for Clarice Starling.
related_events: Electron microscopy analysis reveals matching fabric cuts from Buffalo Bill's victims
Instructor explains scissor cut characteristics in fiber analysis
related_occasions: Fbi Forensic Training Session On Fiber Analysis

name: Brigham Interrupts Fiber Analysis Training
description: A blurry image on a large video screen slowly sharpens, revealing two separate pieces of fabric. The instructor's voice explains that electron microscopy can distinguish fiber patterns as uniquely as fingerprints. The screen shows close-ups of cut fabric edges from two blouses, worn by victims of Buffalo Bill and found months apart in different states. The cuts run up the back, and the frayed threads, thick as tree limbs under magnification, show matching patterns. The instructor points out the compressed threads, indicating the cuts were made with scissors, not a single blade, and that the same pair was used in both cases. Clarice sits at a long table with other trainees, Ardelia beside her. Each student peers into their own microscope. Clarice straightens as she hears her name. John Brigham appears at the door, calling out for her.
related_events: John Brigham interrupts training session to locate Clarice Starling
related_occasions: Fbi Forensic Training Session On Fiber Analysis

name: Crawford Confronts Dr. Danielson for Rejected Patient Records
description: Crawford strides down a hospital corridor beside Dr. Danielson, clutching a folder. He presses the doctor to release records of patients the hospital has turned away, insisting the suspect was never treated there but may have applied under false pretenses. In the nurse's gallery, Danielson pours a cup of coffee and refuses, citing patient confidentiality. Crawford slams a black-and-white photograph onto the counter—a victim, Kimberly Jane Emberg, recently identified. He tells Danielson she was found dead in West Virginia and warns that Catherine Martin will suffer the same fate within days. Danielson calls the move a childish stunt, reminding Crawford of his duty to patient trust. Burroughs appears, announcing a call from Director Burke, but Crawford snaps at him to wait. Composing himself, Crawford offers a compromise: Danielson can review the records himself and only share relevant information, with the FBI suppressing the hospital’s involvement. Danielson remains skeptical, questioning whether the government can keep secrets. Crawford leans in, furious, describing the killer’s crimes in graphic detail and threatening to hold daily press conferences naming Danielson and Johns Hopkins if cooperation is delayed. He vows to tie the doctor’s name to every future victim in the media. Danielson pauses, then stiffly suggests he might consult with colleagues and get back to Crawford. Crawford responds with cold sarcasm, thanking him for the courtesy.
related_events: Crawford confronts Dr. Danielson in hospital corridor
Dr. Danielson refuses to disclose confidential patient records
Crawford presents photograph of victim Kimberly Jane Emberg
Crawford warns of imminent threat to Catherine Martin
Crawford threatens Dr. Danielson with public exposure
Dr. Danielson hesitates and offers to consult colleagues

name: Burroughs Interrupts Crawford During Confrontation
description: As Crawford presses Dr. Danielson in a tense exchange, Burroughs appears in the doorway and calls out that Director Burke is on the phone. Crawford snaps at him to wait, and Burroughs quickly retreats. The moment breaks the intensity of the conversation, but Crawford immediately returns to confronting Danielson.
related_events: Burroughs interrupts Crawford with a phone call from Director Burke

name: Chilton Confronts Clarice in Hospital Corridor
description: Frederick Chilton approaches Clarice Starling quickly in the hospital corridor, stopping her by grabbing her arm. He points at her with a gold pen, demanding to know why she is conducting an interview at his hospital without sharing information with him. He insists that the patient is under his care and that he has rights. Clarice calmly explains that her visit is a routine follow-up on the Raspail case. Chilton protests that he should not be there that afternoon—he had plans to attend Holiday on Ice. Clarice looks at him without speaking, and he releases her arm. She hands him a card with the U.S. Attorney's number and walks away, leaving him standing in the corridor, clicking his pen as he watches her leave.
related_events: Chilton confronts Clarice in hospital corridor
Chilton accuses Clarice of withholding information
Clarice explains purpose of her visit as routine follow-up

name: Clarice Confronts Chilton and Walks Away
description: Chilton grabs Clarice's arm to stop her as she walks down the corridor. She turns to him, hands him a card with the U.S. Attorney's number, and tells him to either take the matter up with the attorney or let her do her job. She walks away without looking back. Chilton stands in place, clicking his pen as he watches her leave.
related_events: Chilton grabs Clarice's arm to stop her
Clarice confronts Chilton with U.S. Attorney's contact
Chilton clicks pen while watching Clarice leave

name: Burke Confronts Jack Over Lecter's Plane
description: FBI Director Hayden Burke sits in his office, flags flanking his desk, speaking urgently into the phone with Jack. He tells Jack that Senator Martin has already landed in Memphis and is furious. Paul Krendler, the Deputy Attorney General, is with Burke, seated across the desk, visibly impatient. Burke asks Jack if he made any promises to Lecter on the Senator’s behalf. As he listens, Burke glances uneasily at Krendler. He informs Jack that Krendler has been asked to take charge in Memphis, but stresses that Jack still leads the task force and has the authority to order Lecter’s plane back. He presses Jack for a decision immediately.
related_events: FBI Director Hayden Burke receives a phone call about Senator Martin's arrival in Memphis
FBI Director questions Jack about making a promise to Lecter in Senator Martin's name
FBI Director Burke informs Jack about Senator Martin's anger and Paul Krendler's involvement
FBI Director Burke gives Jack an urgent decision on recalling Lecter's plane

name: Director Burke Observes Paul Krendler
description: After ending the call with Jack, Director Burke turns his gaze across the desk to Paul Krendler. Krendler sits with an irritable, impatient presence, his posture and expression conveying restlessness. Burke studies him in silence, the weight of the moment settling between them.
related_events: FBI Director observes Deputy Attorney General Paul Krendler across the desk

name: Roden Claims His Turn After the Beetle's Move
description: The rhinoceros beetle stumbles across the chessboard, its heavy body brushing past the carved pieces, and finally steps onto a lettuce leaf placed at the edge. Roden grins and says, 'Tough noogies! It's still my turn.' Pilcher protests, 'No fair! You lured him with produce.' 'It counts,' Roden replies, folding his arms. As the beetle settles on the leaf, Clarice appears in the doorway, asking, 'If the beetle moves one of your men, does that count?' Roden and Pilcher look up, momentarily distracted, both smiling at her arrival.
related_events: Rhinoceros beetle moves across chessboard and steps onto lettuce leaf
Pilcher accuses Roden of luring beetle with produce
Roden declares his turn after beetle's movement

name: Clarice Joins the Chess Game
description: Clarice steps into the room, and the two entomologists look up, their faces lighting with delight at the sight of her. She asks if the beetle moving a chess piece counts as a valid move. Pilcher grins and greets her by name and title, 'Officer Starling. Welcome back.' Roden, still holding a lettuce leaf, tells her of course the move counts and asks, 'How do you play?'
related_events: Clarice enters room and questions beetle's role in gameplay
Roden invites Clarice to play the game

name: Chilton Shows Clarice the Rules and the Photo
description: Chilton walks with Clarice through a dim, heavily secured corridor. He tells her not to reach through the bars or touch them, to pass only soft paper through the food carrier, and never to accept anything from the prisoner. He emphasizes that pens, pencils, staples, and paperclips are forbidden. As they walk, he recounts an incident from July 8, 1981, when the prisoner complained of chest pains and was taken to the dispensary. During an EKG, after his restraints were removed, the prisoner attacked the nurse. Chilton hands Clarice a worn photograph showing the nurse’s injuries. Clarice stops short, visibly shaken. Chilton notes that the prisoner’s pulse never rose above eighty-five, even after biting off her tongue. He presses a button, and a steel door buzzes open, revealing Barney, a large orderly, waiting in an anteroom filled with restraints and security gear. Clarice steps forward to block Chilton and suggests speaking to the prisoner alone, saying he might see Chilton as an enemy. Chilton, irritated, snaps that she should have mentioned it earlier, then snatches the photo back and leaves. Barney greets Clarice, confirms she knows to stay away from the bars, and tells her the prisoner is in the last cell. He points to a chair he has placed for her and indicates a security monitor. "I'm watching," he says. Clarice nods, takes a breath, and walks down the corridor.
related_events: Chilton instructs Clarice on safety procedures for approaching a prisoner
Chilton shows Clarice a photograph of the nurse's injuries
Prisoner attacks nurse during medical examination

name: Barney Guides Clarice to Lecter's Cell
description: After Chilton leaves, Barney introduces himself to Clarice and reminds her not to get near the bars. He tells her to stay in the middle of the corridor and points to a chair he has placed in the last cell. He assures her that he will be watching from the anteroom. Clarice nods, takes a deep breath, and walks down the corridor toward Lecter's cell.
related_events: Chilton leaves after instructing Barney to bring Clarice out
Barney introduces himself to Clarice and gives safety instructions
Clarice walks into the prison corridor toward Lecter's cell

name: Mr. Gumb Forces Catherine to Apply Lotion
description: Mr. Gumb leans over the edge of a deep pit, holding a white poodle in his arms. He orders Catherine Martin, standing fifteen feet below on the cement floor, to rub lotion on her skin. She is soaked, wearing an orange jumpsuit, and holds a squeeze bottle. When she hesitates, he threatens to use the hose again. The dog barks as he repeats the command. Catherine unzips her jumpsuit slightly and begins applying the lotion, whispering under her breath. She pleads for her release, mentioning her mother and offering money, but Mr. Gumb interrupts, correcting her—he has only held her for one day. A floodlamp descends in a basket, and he tells her to place the bottle inside. As she does, she notices something in the dim light—bloody handprints smeared across the walls. She screams, her hand knocking the lamp, casting shadows that reveal the marks stretching high on all sides.
related_events: Mr. Gumb threatens Catherine Martin with a hose
Catherine Martin applies skin lotion under duress
Mr. Gumb asserts control over Catherine Martin

name: Catherine Pleads for Her Freedom
description: Catherine Martin stands at the bottom of a deep concrete pit, soaked and shivering in an orange jumpsuit. Above her, Mr. Gumb leans over the edge, cradling a small white poodle and stroking it gently. She calls up to him, her voice strained but controlled, offering that her family will pay any ransom in cash. She promises not to press charges if he lets her go, insisting it’s only been a couple of days. Mr. Gumb interrupts, correcting her—only one day. She continues, mentioning her mother’s importance and suggesting he might be acting for a cause like Iran or Palestine, offering that her family will comply without question. He ignores her plea and orders her to put the lotion bottle in a basket descending on a string. When the basket reaches her, she moves to place the bottle inside but stops, noticing something in the edge of the light. She stares, then begins to scream, her hand knocking the floodlamp as it swings, revealing dark, dried bloody handprints smeared across the walls around her.
related_events: Catherine Martin pleads for her release

name: Catherine Discovers the Handprints
description: Mr. Gumb lowers a basket attached to a floodlamp into the pit, ordering Catherine Martin to place the lotion bottle inside. As she sets the bottle in the basket, her eyes catch a glimpse of something in the edge of the light—bloody finger marks streaked across the concrete walls. She stares, taking in the dried tracks left by desperate hands, and suddenly screams, over and over, her voice echoing in the chamber. Her arm swings out in panic, striking the lamp. It swings violently, casting jagged shadows that reveal more of the grim marks lining the walls all around her.
related_events: Mr. Gumb demands Catherine Martin place the lotion bottle in the descending basket
Catherine Martin discovers bloody finger tracks on the walls
Catherine Martin screams in horror upon seeing evidence of prior victims
Catherine Martin accidentally knocks the floodlamp while reacting to the handprints

name: Clarice Enters the Facility with Chilton
description: Clarice steps into a secure facility as a heavy steel gate clangs shut behind her, the bolt locking into place. Chilton walks ahead of her, speaking about Hannibal Lecter. He tells her that Lecter killed nine people—those they know of—and cooked parts of them. Chilton says they have tried to study Lecter, but he is too intelligent for standard tests. He adds that Lecter hates them, especially seeing Chilton as his nemesis. Chilton suggests that Jack Crawford sent Clarice because she is a young woman, implying that her presence might affect Lecter, who hasn’t seen a woman in eight years. Clarice responds that she graduated magna from UVA, and this isn’t a charm school. Chilton replies that she should remember the rules.
related_events: Steel gate slams shut behind Clarice
Chilton walks ahead of Clarice while discussing Lecter
Chilton reveals Lecter's cannibalism and intellectual superiority

name: Chilton's Insinuations and Clarice's Rebuttal
description: A heavy steel gate clangs shut behind Clarice as Chilton walks ahead of her. He tells her that Lecter carved up nine people and cooked his favorite parts, adding that Lecter hates them and sees him as a nemesis. Chilton suggests that Crawford is using Clarice because she is a young woman, implying her appearance might provoke Lecter, who hasn't seen a woman in eight years. Clarice responds by stating she graduated magna from UVA, emphasizing it is not a charm school. Chilton tells her to remember the rules.
related_events: Chilton accuses Crawford of manipulating Clarice
Chilton implies Clarice might provoke Lecter's interest due to her appearance
Clarice asserts her academic credentials in response to Chilton's condescension

name: Chilton Reminds Clarice of the Rules
description: Chilton turns to Clarice after the steel gate clangs shut behind them. He tells her that Lecter has not seen a woman in eight years and implies that her presence might be used to provoke a reaction. Clarice responds that she graduated magna from UVA and is not there for charm. Chilton says she should then remember the rules for interacting with Lecter.
related_events: Chilton reminds Clarice of the established rules for interacting with Lecter

name: Clarice Exits the Asylum and Finds Her Car
description: Clarice bursts through the front doors of the asylum, unsteady on her feet, rubbing at her face as if trying to erase what she’s just experienced. She stumbles across the pavement, scanning the area until her eyes land on her old Pinto parked nearby. A brief flicker of relief crosses her face. She reaches the car and leans against it, pressing her forehead into her arms. Her shoulders tremble as the sound of rapid gunshots echoes in the distance.
related_events: Clarice exits asylum in distress
Clarice spots her car with relief

name: Clarice Remembers Her Father
description: Clarice stumbles out of the asylum, rubbing her face, her breath uneven. She spots her old Pinto parked nearby and rushes toward it. As she leans against the car, her vision blurs. A screen door slams open on a wooden porch. A young girl—ten years old, barefoot—runs down the steps and across a dusty yard toward a car parked in the road. A man steps out—tall, wearing a dark suit with a marshal’s badge. He sees her, grins, and opens his arms. The girl leaps into them. He catches her, lifts her high, and spins her around. Her laughter rises as the world turns with them. The image fades. Clarice stands alone in the parking lot, her face pressed into her arms, her body trembling. A burst of gunshots echoes in the distance.
related_events: Clarice experiences a flashback of her childhood
Clarice's father greets young Clarice with a joyful hug and spin

name: Clarice Breaks Down as Gunshots Ring Out
description: Clarice staggers to her car, her face pressed into her arms as she sags against the door. Her shoulders tremble, breath coming in ragged hitches. The quiet is shattered by a rapid burst of gunshots, sharp and close, cutting through the air. She flinches, lifting her head, her expression frozen in shock.
related_events: Adult Clarice breaks down emotionally at her car
Gunshots interrupt the scene abruptly

name: Clarice Studies Lecter's News Article and Takes Notes
description: Clarice sits at a microfilm monitor in the FBI academy, watching a grainy newsphoto of Dr. Lecter from 1980 scroll past, accompanied by a news story titled 'New Horizons in Cannibal Trial.' She types on a terminal, then pauses to jot down notes on a pad. Other trainees work quietly at nearby tables. Ardelia passes by, carrying books, and tells Clarice she has a phone call. Clarice grabs her notebook and heads toward the check-out desk where the phone waits.
related_events: Clarice views news article about Dr. Lecter on microfilm monitor
Clarice takes notes during research session

name: Ardelia Brings a Message and Teases Clarice
description: Ardelia walks by Clarice’s table, carrying a stack of books, and tells her she has a phone call, joking that it’s from God. Clarice thanks her, and Ardelia asks where she was all afternoon, mentioning she missed Fourth Amendment law class. Clarice replies that she was pleading with a crazy man, with come all over her face. Ardelia stares for a moment, then laughs, saying she wishes she had time for a social life. Clarice grins as Ardelia points to the phone waiting on the check-out desk. Clarice picks up the receiver and says, 'Mr. Crawford?'
related_events: Ardelia delivers phone call message to Clarice
Ardelia teases Clarice about missing Fourth Amendment law class
Clarice responds to Ardelia with a sarcastic remark about pleading with a crazy man

name: Clarice Takes the Call from Mr. Crawford
description: Clarice follows Ardelia past the high metal bookstacks. Ardelia gestures toward a phone receiver resting on the check-out desk. Clarice picks it up and speaks into the phone. 'Mr. Crawford?'
related_events: Clarice follows Ardelia past bookstacks after receiving message
Ardelia indicates phone receiver on check-out desk for Clarice
Clarice picks up phone receiver to speak with Mr. Crawford

name: Inspecting the Damaged Cocoon in the Insect Hallway
description: Clarice walks quickly down a hallway lined with mounted insects, accompanied by Roden and Pilcher. She carries a box containing a damaged cocoon. Roden peers at the specimen, noting that it is nearly mush, and asks where it came from. Clarice replies that he really doesn’t want to know. Pilcher mentions that the West Virginia specimen caused trouble but was eventually identified through analysis of the skin. Roden interrupts, insisting he was the one who discovered its perforating proboscis. He then asks Clarice if she is carrying a gun. When she nods, he excitedly asks if he can see it. Pilcher tells him to be ignored, adding that he doesn’t have a Ph.D.
related_events: Clarice and two men walk quickly through insect-lined hallway
Roden examines Clarice's damaged cocoon specimen
Roden claims credit for discovering perforating proboscis

name: Pilcher and Roden Debate Their Contributions on the West Virginia Specimen
description: Pilcher explains that he identified the species of the West Virginia specimen through chaetaxy, analyzing the skin. Roden interrupts, insisting he was the one who discovered the creature's perforating proboscis. As they speak, Roden turns to Clarice and notices she is carrying a gun, asking excitedly if he can see it. Pilcher tells her to ignore him, adding that Roden doesn't have a Ph.D.

He lies with his arms folded, his marshal’s badge still on his lapel. The hymn swells, mingling with quiet sobs. The faces of those around her blur. Clarice explains she searched the mainframe but found no record, as Lecter had destroyed most of his patient files. She recalls that 'Split City' sounded like it might relate to divorce and discovered it is a mini-storage facility outside Baltimore, where Lecter once practiced. She waits for a response, but Crawford asks why she isn't already there. Clarice hesitates, saying the task falls outside her assignment and she has a test the next day. Crawford reminds her of his original instructions to complete and file the report by Wednesday, telling her to do exactly that. After a pause, he informs her that Miggs has been murdered—found dead after swallowing his own tongue, an act Lecter provoked. Chilton is afraid of a lawsuit and is trying to blame Clarice, though Crawford defended her. He tells her not to dwell on how it makes her feel, emphasizing that Lecter did it for amusement. He tells her to continue the investigation on her own time, outside of class. The call ends with a sharp click. Clarice stares at the phone, then slams it down, muttering curses under her breath. name: Clarice Reviews the Buffalo Bill File
description: On a plane, Clarice sits by the window, the case file 'BUFFALO BILL' in her lap. She hesitates, then opens it. Inside, she finds police forms, some handwritten, and typed lab reports with headings like 'Autopsy Protocols' and 'Histamine Analysis.' There are grainy enlargements of bullet slugs showing matched grooves. She turns to a stack of photographs. The first shows a nude woman lying face down on a riverbank, surrounded by litter. Clarice pauses, then flips to the next photo, flinching slightly. She quickly turns through several more, her expression tense. Crawford stands over her, swaying with the motion of the plane, then sits down, removing his sunglasses.

name: Crawford Details Buffalo Bill's Methods to Clarice
description: Crawford tells Clarice that Buffalo Bill keeps his victims alive for three days before shooting and skinning them, with all mutilation occurring after death. He notes there is no evidence of rape or physical abuse prior to death. The bodies are dumped in rivers in different states, each downstream from an interstate highway, which washes away fingerprints, fibers, and DNA. The first victim, Fredrica Bimmel, was a heavyset girl weighing about 160 pounds, and her body was weighted down before being placed in the river. The other victims were not weighted, and their bodies were found in different locations. Crawford shows Clarice a photo of Fredrica in her graduation gown and points out the dump sites on a map, marking the latest location on the Elk River in West Virginia, six miles below U.S. 79.

name: Moth Emerges as Lecter Guides Investigation
description: A Death's-head Moth wriggles free from a cocoon split along its back, damp and trembling as it clings to a sprig of nightshade. The camera pulls back to reveal a wire cage holding several moths crawling across humus or feeding at honeycombs, their wings pumping lazily. Show music plays distantly, growing louder—a jaunty tune by Fats Waller, "Bye Bye Baby." A continuous moving shot travels through a dimly lit cellar, passing a stainless-steel work table, a large sink, jars of chemicals, and racks of gleaming knives. Rows of female mannequins stand nearby, some nude, others wearing colorful leather jackets, unfinished. A large Chinese lacquer armoire sits with its doors slightly ajar. The sound of a sewing machine clicks rapidly. Dr. Lecter's voice speaks calmly over the scene, suggesting a list of males rejected from gender reassignment centers, particularly those who lied about criminal records or had severe childhood disturbances, including incarceration. He advises reviewing personality tests and focusing on drawings—houses without signs of happiness, trees that are frightening, female figures crudely rendered but adorned with exaggerated jewelry and features. The camera turns a corner and reveals Mr. Gumb, his back wide and hunched over a sewing machine, bare feet pumping the treadle. He hums along to the music, a wig resting on a head form beside him, a beautiful kimono draped over his shoulders. A small dog, Precious, perches near his ankles. As the camera passes, Precious darts away, following a new path down a corridor as the music fades. From a dark chamber at the end, the dog approaches a circular opening in the floor—the oubliette—and barks. A hoarse, desperate voice rises from below: "Pleeeeeeeease.....!"

name: Clarice Profiles the Killer on the Mountain Road
description: Crawford steers the car along a winding mountain road, following a highway patrol vehicle. Clarice sits beside him, the file open on her lap. He glances at her and asks her to talk about the killer. She begins carefully, describing the man as a white male who likely owns a house, not an apartment, someone who needs privacy and time. She estimates he is in his thirties or forties, physically strong but controlled, deliberate in his actions, not impulsive. Crawford listens, then asks why she believes the killings won’t end in suicide. Clarice replies that the killer enjoys what he’s doing and is improving. Crawford pauses, then says she might have a knack for this work. Clarice responds quietly, asking if that’s how he saw her with Dr. Lecter. Crawford studies her. She confronts him about the garage and what she found there, accusing him of knowing Lecter was the key and sending her in without protection. He tells her she did good work and that if he had given her anything to hide, Lecter would have sensed it immediately. She starts to reply, then falls silent.

name: Clarice Responds in Training Simulation
description: Clarice entered the simulated room and saw a woman sitting on the edge of a bed, gagged, with her hands behind her back. A man stood by the window, turning toward her with a rifle in his hands. Clarice dropped into a crouch, leveled her gun, and shouted, "Freeze! FBI!" The man faced her, the rifle rising across his chest, his hands taped to the weapon. The woman behind the bed suddenly pulled a revolver from her back and fired. Clarice rolled sideways, came up beside an armchair, and returned fire with two shots. The woman fell backward over the bed, then lay still. Clarice moved to her, pressing a knee into the woman's gun hand and keeping her covered. A whistle sounded. The lights brightened. The exercise ended.

His hands are taped to the weapon, away from the trigger. As he faces her, a metallic click sounds. The hostage pulls a revolver from behind her back and fires. Clarice drops, rolls to the side, and comes up beside an armchair. She fires two shots. The woman pitches backward over the bed and lies still in a haze of smoke. name: Roden and Pilcher Examine Moth Specimens
description: Roden leans over a formica table, using tweezers and a dental probe to carefully extract a sodden chrysalis from a sliced cocoon under the lens of a square magnifier. He works slowly, speaking without looking up, warning that the wings are as delicate as wet tissue paper. Pilcher focuses on another specimen nearby, examining a large brown moth with its wings spread on a sheet of towel paper. The two men work in silence for a moment, surrounded by stainless trays and magnifying lenses. Clarice watches them closely, standing slightly apart. Roden straightens suddenly, pointing with his probe. He announces a positive match—West Virginia, Baltimore. He steps aside, inviting Clarice to look. She moves in and sees the moth’s broad, furry back, and between the wing bases, the distinct, eerie marking of a human skull. Pilcher notes the moth’s Latin name, Acherontia Styx, and adds that it originates from rivers in Hell. He recalls that the killer always places the victims in rivers. Clarice asks if the moths could have gotten into the bodies naturally. Pilcher shakes his head—these moths live in Malaysia and would have to be raised here from imported eggs. A pause. Clarice whispers, 'Dr. Lecter.' The two men turn to her, confused. Then, the sound of police sirens rises in the distance.
